intro a
use 1
intro h
have h1 : 0 < 1 := zero_lt_one
have h2 : 0 < a ∨ 0 < 1 := by rw [h]; exact or.inl (zero_lt_one)
cases h2 with h3 h4
· have h5 : 0 < a := h3
  have h6 : 0 < a * 1 := mul_pos h5 h1
  have h7 : a * 1 < 1 * 1 := mul_lt_mul h5 h1 h1 h1
  exact h7
· have h8 : 0 < 1 := h4
  have h9 : 0 < 1 * 1 := mul_pos h8 h8
  have h10 : a * 1 < 1 * 1 := by rw [h]; exact lt_reflect h9
  exact h10
